zh.title: 说明
items: **0.0.2-beta.5** 把 Desktop 工作台做成真正的任务中心：全局工作台与工作区视图分离、任务总览/历史抽屉、结果验收动画与继续推进，并补齐侧边栏工作区树、Skill 胶囊与若干聊天/用量体验修复。
Skill 侧补齐工具定义、卸载路径、Header 能力列表打开详情，以及 SkillHub 安装错误的可读反馈。
本版不改变本地能力执行、显式授权与 Evidence 边界。

zh.title: 新功能
items: **全局工作台**：与工作区视图分离，集中查看进行中任务、结果待验收与历史；支持任务总览与历史抽屉。
**推进中任务卡片**：展示 plan 步骤，可继续未验收结果对应的同一任务；验收卡片支持整卡右到左碎裂退场与过渡动画。
**结果就绪信息**：待验收卡片显示完成时间；验收队列会丢弃已过期的未验收结果，避免脏队列。
**后台 shell 线程**：Peer 后台 shell 线程可在工作台中看见。
**侧边栏工作区树**：侧边栏压平为工作区树；新建对话可先选 draft 工作区，已有会话锁定所属工作区。
**正在讨论**：最近讨论改为仅展示未读的「正在讨论」，并记录 lastReadAt / markRead 水位。
**任务上下文**：会话侧可表面 conversation task 上下文；Dock 悬停可看全部 goal 步骤。
**Skill 体验**：Header 能力列表可打开技能详情；展示 skill 胶囊；SkillHub 安装错误更可读；补齐 skill tool 定义、provider 通道接线与卸载。
**缓存与用量**：缓存 metrics 引擎与 prompt prefix 稳定化；ChatGPT Responses 上报 prompt cache hit tokens。

zh.title: 优化
items: 聊天输入区：统一 padding、停止按钮更大、操作行与附件 chip 间距、编辑中 banner 改为纯文案、模型条使用控件级字号。
切换会话时恢复上次上下文用量显示。
验收卡片折叠后列表上滑，工作台结果卡恢复双栏。
用量趋势图圆角更顺；任务总览文案更短。
流式自动滚动时保持已打开 tooltip；running 圆点接入状态 token。

zh.title: 修复
items: 继续未验收结果时重开同一任务，而不是另起一条。
等待用户输入的任务在工作台正确露出。
修复 GlobalWorkbenchPage 中 `durationLabel is not defined` 崩溃。
工作区切换后正确打开工作台；侧边栏行不再裁切。
流式滚动不再因 virtual spacer 不同步而弹跳。
任务总览最近讨论展示 6 条；讨论状态 fallback 断言对齐。
Qoder 本地鉴权：errno 映射为可读错误，并在鉴权读取时回退 host node。
provider 流式元数据、skill id 提取与任务总览规则修正。
Skill 详情关闭图标几何居中；技能卡片圆角对齐。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: 本版 GitHub Release 附带 CLI 归档（与 Desktop 同 tag / 同版本）。
TUI 新增 `/version` slash 命令，可直接查看 CLI 版本。
资产示例：`peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz`（内含 `peer` + `peer-credential-helper`，**必须同目录**）。
安装方式：
**npm（有 `NPM_TOKEN` 且 publish 成功时）**：`npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`（或 `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`），`postinstall` 自动拉本版归档。
**手动**：解压归档后将目录加入 `PATH`，执行 `peer --version` 校验，再运行 `peer`。
可不装 Desktop；会话与设置仍落在 `~/.peer-agent`，与客户端共享。

en.title: Notes
items: **0.0.2-beta.5** turns the Desktop workbench into a real task hub: a global workbench separate from workspace views, task overview/history drawers, result-acceptance animations and continue-task flows, plus a flattened workspace sidebar tree, skill capsules, and chat/usage polish.
Skills gain tool definitions, uninstall paths, header capability-list detail entry, and more readable SkillHub install errors.
Local capability execution, explicit authorization, and Evidence remain unchanged.

en.title: What's New
items: **Global workbench**: separated from workspace views to centralize in-progress tasks, results awaiting acceptance, and history, with task overview and history drawers.
**Advancing task cards**: show plan steps and continue the same task for unaccepted results; accept cards can shatter right-to-left with transition animation.
**Result-ready metadata**: completion time on cards waiting for acceptance; the acceptance queue drops stale unaccepted results.
**Background shell threads**: Peer background shell threads are visible in the workbench.
**Workspace sidebar tree**: sidebar flattens into a workspace tree; new chats can pick a draft workspace first, and existing chats keep a locked workspace.
**Active discussions**: recent discussions become unread-only “discussing”, with lastReadAt / markRead watermarks.
**Task context**: conversation task context is surfaced in chat; dock hover shows the full goal step list.
**Skill UX**: open skill detail from the header capability list; show skill capsules; make SkillHub install errors readable; add skill tool definitions, provider channel wiring, and uninstall.
**Cache & usage**: cache metrics engine and prompt-prefix stabilization; ChatGPT Responses reports prompt cache hit tokens.

en.title: Improvements
items: Chat composer: unified padding, larger stop glyph, action-row/attach-chip spacing, text-only editing banner, control-level model-strip font.
Restore last context-usage display when switching sessions.
Collapse accept cards so the list slides up; restore dual-column workbench result cards.
Smoother usage-trend chart corners; shorter task-overview copy.
Keep open tooltips during stream auto-scroll; wire the running dot to the status token.

en.title: Fixes
items: Continuing unaccepted results reopens the same task instead of starting another.
Waiting-for-user tasks surface correctly in the workbench.
Fix `durationLabel is not defined` crash in GlobalWorkbenchPage.
Open the workbench correctly after workspace switches; stop sidebar rows from clipping.
Stop streaming scroll bounce from an out-of-sync virtual spacer.
Show six recent discussions on the task overview; align discussion-status fallback assertions.
Qoder local auth: map errno codes to readable errors and fall back to the host node for auth reads.
Fix provider stream metadata, skill id extraction, and task-overview rules.
Center the skill-detail close icon geometrically; align skill card radius.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: This GitHub Release also ships CLI archives (same tag / version as Desktop).
TUI adds a `/version` slash command to show the CLI version.
Asset example: `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz` (contains `peer` + `peer-credential-helper`; **must stay side-by-side**).
Install:
**npm (when `NPM_TOKEN` is present and publish succeeds)**: `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta` (or `pnpm add -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`); `postinstall` fetches this version's archive.
**Manual**: extract the archive, add the directory to `PATH`, run `peer --version`, then `peer`.
Desktop is optional; sessions and settings still live under `~/.peer-agent` and are shared with the client.
